story_text: As a guest, I want the system to reject a booking where check-out is before check-in so that invalid date ranges are prevented.

positive.title: Create a booking with the check-in date is later than the check-out date
steps: 1. Navigate to the endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. At the date fields switch the dates
4. Click submit
positive.expected_result: An error message prompting user this action can't be done

positive.title: Correct error message is returned for invalid date range
steps: 1. Navigate to the endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. At the date fields switch the dates
4. Click submit

negative.title: Booking with check-out after check-in is accepted normally
steps: 1. Navigate to the endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. At the date fields switch the dates
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: An error message prompting user this action can't be done

edge.title: Booking is rejected when check-out and check-in are the same date
steps: 1. Navigate to the endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Set the date fields on the dates
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error message prompting user this action can't be done

edge.title: Booking with check-out one day before check-in is rejected
steps: 1. Navigate to the endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. At the date fields switch the dates
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: An error message prompting user this action can't be done
